I found you a year ago on this day, and I promised to wish you not virtually the next time around. I failed the geography of that promise, but not the truth of it. This is not just pixels on a screen. It is a heartbeat… Happy Birthday. It’s late. Or early. The hours no longer obey logic when my mind settles on your name. I am writing this because I don’t know how to be quiet when it comes to you.
